metadata.changes: Temporary TU adds an extra instantiation of actual production header with max_num_out > 2; unchanged actual production > 1 in same executable; randomized three-arm timings with original reference. Production unmodified.
metadata.anomaly: Temporary experiment process reported exit0 but retained output has861 of867 expected rows: cases0..15 each retain2warmups+15measured rounds; finalcase16(n26,L160,M147,num_in3) retains2warmups+13measured rounds, missing rounds15and16. Raw output has not been replaced or reconstructed. Finalcase excluded from threshold decision; summary uses actual13 paired repetitions for that case.
metadata.source_archive_note: production-threshold1.h preserves the exact header used by the compiled actual vpoly0 arm (hash verified), recovered by the inverse one-character substitution from threshold2.h. Current production source later advanced to final >2. Reproducing this temporary comparison requires an isolated source tree using that archived >1 header for rate.c; never overwrite current production.
